# סולגג | SOLGAG — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> SOLGAG (סולגג) is a premium Israeli solar energy installation company with a bold black-and-yellow brand identity. The company targets homeowners, businesses, factories, and commercial buildings, offering end-to-end solar solutions including engineering design, professional installation, utility coordination, and post-installation service. The brand tone is serious, trustworthy, and results-driven — emphasizing financial returns, energy independence, and long-term ROI. The website vision is high-tech and premium, featuring realistic rooftop solar imagery, a built-in solar calculator tool, and a multi-page lead generation funnel designed for the Israeli market in Hebrew RTL layout.

The company targets homeowners, businesses, factories, and commercial buildings, offering end-to-end solar solutions including engineering design, professional installation, utility coordination, and post-installation service. The brand tone is serious, trustworthy, and results-driven — emphasizing financial returns, energy independence, and long-term ROI. The website vision is high-tech and premium, featuring realistic rooftop solar imagery, a built-in solar calculator tool, and a multi-page lead generation funnel designed for the Israeli market in Hebrew RTL layout.
